evals.prompt: 帮我完成一个数学建模题：根据给定城市交通流量数据，建立模型预测未来一周拥堵指数，并生成 report.md。
evals.expected_output: Decomposes into subtasks (data analysis, model selection, prediction, validation). Uses Actor-Critic to refine problem analysis. Selects time-series or regression baseline with justification. Writes runnable Python code with iterative debugging. Generates figures. Produces structured report with sensitivity analysis and self-evaluation score.

evals.prompt: 这是一个资源分配建模问题，目标是在预算约束下最大化覆盖率。帮我建模、求解、做敏感性分析。
evals.expected_output: Identifies optimization model (LP/MIP). Uses Actor-Critic for model formulation. Defines variables, objective, constraints mathematically. Solves with scipy or PuLP. Iteratively debugs code. Checks constraint satisfaction. Reports sensitivity to budget parameter with sweep table and figure.

evals.prompt: 根据多个指标评价几种方案的优劣，帮我选择合适的数学模型并写成建模论文。
evals.expected_output: Selects evaluation method (entropy weight + TOPSIS or AHP) with justification from HMML library. Uses Actor-Critic to critique method choice. Computes weights and rankings. Generates comparison figures. Writes complete report with LaTeX template option.

evals.prompt: MCM 2025 Problem C: 给定运动数据，建模分析运动员表现趋势并预测未来表现。需要完整的建模论文。
evals.expected_output: Full 4-stage pipeline. Decomposes into 4+ subtasks with DAG. Uses prediction methods from HMML. Actor-Critic refinement at each stage. Iterative code debugging. Sensitivity analysis. Generates LaTeX report with mcmthesis template. Self-evaluation score ≥35/50.

evals.prompt: 建立一个传染病传播模型，分析不同防控措施的效果。
evals.expected_output: Selects compartmental model (SIR/SEIR) from HMML. Decomposes into model construction, parameter estimation, scenario comparison. Implements ODE solver. Generates time-trajectory plots. Sensitivity analysis on transmission rate and recovery rate. Validates against known epidemic behavior.
